settings.heading: Which size
settings.content:
Skip the tape measure. Medium is the standard hand — take it unless you have reason not to. Choose Small for a narrower hand: if your rings sit under a size 6, or if you like a glove close enough to forget you put it on.

Small is a 6½ inch hand (17.6 cm). Medium is 7 inches (18.9 cm).

If you would rather be certain — stretch out your dominant hand, wrap a tape measure around the knuckles, then bend it a little without clenching. Land between two sizes and you take the smaller, which is Glove Story's own advice.

settings.heading: Care
settings.content: Spot clean with a barely damp cloth. Never machine wash. Let them dry away from direct heat, and store them flat — the bottom of the purse is fine.

settings.heading: Shipping & returns
settings.content: Sent the long way on purpose. Gracious, calm returns within 30 days — write to the house and we'll sort it.

settings.heading: The maker
settings.content: Glove Story, in France. Chosen by the house for In Her Purse, not made by it. The house makes some things and finds others; this is one it found.
